coordinateBasis: Verified writer native millimetres (X,Y,Z) -> runtime metres (X,Z,-Y)/1000; native rear Y=0,+Y outward maps runtime rear Z=0,-Z outward.
limits: All rear-plane facets and their authored corner normals inspected; normal checks exclude non-rear side facets which legitimately share rear edge positions.
Planar triangle union is compared to pinned native body tessellation; this is not an assertion of exact welded topology elsewhere.
Actual app rear view remains the appearance authority; CPU preview shading is not used as geometry evidence.
